# Changelog
All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## [Unreleased]

## [1.3.2] - 2022-06-04
### Changed
- Removed dependency on `content-disposition` which was requiring
  Node.js polyfills.
- Removed references to `global` in code. Instead, it now uses `globalThis`.
  If you're targeting browsers, you may need to polyfill `globalThis`.

## [1.2.308] - 2022-04-11
### Changed
- Updated npm dependencies to latest versions as of 2022-04-11.
- Renamed `defaultParams` to `defaultArgs`.

## [1.2.195] - 2022-03-01
### Fixed
- Numeric strings are now deserializable to `Int64`.

## [1.2.192] - 2022-03-01
### Fixed
- `BigInt` path components are now correctly handled in URLs.

## [1.2.181] - 2022-02-28
### Fixed
- Updated dependencies on `bignumber.js` and `json-bigint` so
  that the dependency on `bignumber.js` would not resolve to
  multiple versions.

## [1.2.168] - 2022-02-15
### Fixed
- Decoders now generate correct TypeScript types for optional
  values.
- Changed encoder types in TypeScript to declare that they
  produce `unknown` since it's JSON that goes over the wire. 

## [1.2.151] - 2022-02-11
### Added
- Path components in `Configuration.serverURL` are now preserved.

## [1.2.90] - 2022-01-07
### Added
- Support for array values in multipart forms.

## [1.2.23] - 2021-12-02
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue limiting request bodies to a single item.

## [1.2.15] - 2021-11-30
### Added
- Initial release.
